page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the instance delivers modest processing capabilities. In stress-ng and Geekbench testing, both single-core and multi-core CPU performance fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block speed of 39.24 GB/sec and a write large block speed of 34.3 GB/sec, placing write performance in the average tier while read performance remains weak. Cryptographic and compression tasks, such as gzip compression and Passmark encryption tests, also rank in the lower percentiles. However, the CPU supports AVX and AVX512F instructions, which helps it achieve average scores in Passmark extended instructions tests.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio combined with lower compute performance, the ecs.se1ne.2xlarge is best suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require intensive CPU processing. This includes caching layers, small-scale database operations, and lightweight memory-bound applications. It is less optimal for compute-heavy tasks like large-scale software compilation, intensive text processing, or complex LLM inference, where benchmarks show poor to weak performance.
